text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAHHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(Aah! This is so fun, everyone! So much 
fun! Suzuka, you're fast! Air Groove, 
you're so strong!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: (Still—)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Kh... I cannot afford to lose here! As the 
"Empress"——!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Haa, ngh...! Am I pushed too far 
forward...? But I have to...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(Is Suzuka feeling a bit hesitant? Is Air 
Groove putting too much pressure on 
herself?)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(Then right now! Right here, right now, 
feel Marvelous with me! Fill your heart to 
the brim with Marvelous!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: (If I do that, then surely—☆)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhhh☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*, ahaha! Ahahahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelouuuuus...☆

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Haa, phew... Good grief! I got so absorbed 
in that, I feel ready to collapse...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haa... phew—heh, hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Lately, I've often found myself 
racing with all sorts of things on my 
mind, but... She completely emptied my 
head.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous-san... I got caught up in her 
lively running.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, it was fun.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... What's this, look like you've 
snapped out of it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah... Did I look like I was 
possessed...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, you're right. Maybe I was a bit 
lost. About which path I should run..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Still... yeah. I can't just keep 
overthinking things—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I won't forget. The fun you allowed me to 
experience today."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
And... I want to run in my own way. 
Forever forward... forever beyond.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, that sounds good.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...What about you? What did you want to 
do?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh. ...Now I want to run against that one 
again.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We're heading for the Japan Cup. To 
fulfill my duty as the Empress—showing 
them the ideal running, the ideal 
strength—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And in addition to that...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
My heart racing at the thought of racing 
that guy... yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After delivering a brilliant run at the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn), Marvelous Sunday takes 
her first steps toward her next goal, the 
Japan Cup—
